title: A Hybrid Computational Intelligence Framework for scRNA-seq Imputation: Integrating scRecover and Random Forests
abstract: arXiv:2511.16923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables transcriptomic profiling at cellular resolution but suffers from pervasive dropout events that obscure biological signals. We present SCR-MF, a modular two-stage workflow that combines principled dropout detection using scRecover with robust non-parametric imputation via missForest. Across public and simulated datasets, SCR-MF achieves robust and interpretable performance comparable to or exceeding existing imputation methods in most cases, while preserving biological fidelity and transparency. Runtime analysis demonstrates that SCR-MF provides a competitive balance between accuracy and computational efficiency, making it suitable for mid-scale single-cell datasets.

translated_title: 一种用于单细胞RNA测序数据插补的混合计算智能框架：整合scRecover与随机森林
translated_abstract: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）能够在细胞分辨率下进行转录组分析，但普遍存在的dropout事件会掩盖生物信号。我们提出了SCR-MF，这是一个模块化的两阶段工作流程，将基于scRecover的原则性dropout检测与通过missForest实现的稳健非参数插补相结合。在公开数据集和模拟数据集上的实验表明，SCR-MF在大多数情况下实现了与现有插补方法相当或更优的稳健且可解释的性能，同时保持了生物保真度和透明度。运行时间分析表明，SCR-MF在准确性与计算效率之间提供了有竞争力的平衡，使其适用于中等规模的单细胞数据集。
tldr: 提出SCR-MF混合框架，将scRecover的dropout检测与missForest随机森林插补相结合，在准确性、可解释性和计算效率之间取得平衡，适用于中等规模单细胞RNA测序数据插补。
en_tdlr: SCR-MF, a hybrid framework integrating scRecover-based dropout detection with missForest random forest imputation, achieves a competitive balance between accuracy, interpretability, and computational efficiency for mid-scale scRNA-seq imputation.
